modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use a per-module matrix bound to physical SXM GPU, board and thermal zone across IB/OOB/Web with aligned timestamps.

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The source does not define whether GB_SXM is one grouped sensor or a per-module population and criteria jump from 2 to 94. DeepSeek targets an unconfirmed aggregate label, truncates evidence and records a malformed OOB fallback.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Passive collection is feasible; membership, module mapping, limits and source clarification are supplyable owner inputs.

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Functionality row 2037 Wistron-BMC-01056-V002: define the exact GB_SXM sensor population, expected module count, SXM/GPU/board/thermal-zone numbering and per-member units/ranges/states; decide whether any grouped record preserves every module, and confirm whether Criteria 1, 2, 94 is only misnumbered or Criteria 3–93 are missing.

review_improvement: Expands GB_SXM to explicit physical modules, requires complete three-surface evidence, preserves GPU fault context and rejects the unconfirmed/malformed truncated command path.
independent_technical_reasoning: SXM systems contain multiple physically distinct GPU modules, so an indexed sensor must be tied to the correct module and board zone before its reading can be accepted. A grouped value may conceal one missing or overheated module unless its aggregation is specified. Complete per-member identity and aligned observations are therefore necessary, while changing GPU policy or clearing logs would destroy or alter the evidence.
